name: EMARS v1.0 reanalysis, Mars Year 30 (6° × 5.14°, hourly, analysis ensemble mean)
citation: Greybush, S. J., Kalnay, E., Wilson, R. J., Hoffman, R. N., Nehrkorn, T., Leidner, M., et al. (2018). The Ensemble Mars Atmosphere Reanalysis System (EMARS) Version 1.0 Dataset. Penn State Data Commons. doi:10.18113/D3W375; Greybush, S. J. et al. (2019). The Ensemble Mars Atmosphere Reanalysis System (EMARS) Version 1.0. Geoscience Data Journal 6(2), 137–150. doi:10.1002/gdj3.77; read from Bhattacharya, A. (2026). ARCO-EMARS: Analysis-Ready Cloud-Optimized EMARS Reanalysis. Hugging Face. doi:10.57967/hf/8859. Mars Year 30, hourly analysis ensemble mean of the lowest model level; winds averaged from the staggered grid onto the mass points; the two half-width polar rows (poleward of 87.43°) are not used.

store_title: dune-atlas Mars cell store: EMARS v1.0 reanalysis (Mars Year 30) hourly lowest-level winds, air state and sand-flux fields at 64 grain sizes
series_note: u, v = analysis-mean U and V of the lowest model level averaged onto the mass points (U from the two latu rows bounding the cell row, V from the two lonv columns bounding the cell column); T = lowest-level temperature; rho = p/(R T) with p the mid pressure of the lowest layer (hybrid interfaces ak, bk); z = (R T/g) ln(p_lo/p) with p_lo = ak[-1] + bk[-1] ps; float32 with mantissas rounded to series_keepbits (|error| <= 0.005 m/s, 0.02 K, 0.05 % rho, 1 mm z). Fields are computed from the unrounded values.
ls_definition: areocentric solar longitude, EMARS Ls (ARCO-EMARS anal_mean_Ls, deg); Mars Year 30 is every hour labelled MY 30 (anal_mean_MY), Ls 0.011 to 359.990 deg
sol_definition: sol of Mars Year 30 plus hour/24: ARCO-EMARS mars_soy (EMARS sol minus 4863; 0 is the sol in which Ls passes 0 deg) + mars_hour/24, one sample per Mars hour, 0.833 to 669.375
pyramid_source: Fields computed for the Mars dune atlas from the EMARS v1.0 reanalysis (Greybush et al. 2018, doi:10.18113/D3W375; read from ARCO-EMARS, doi:10.57967/hf/8859), Mars Year 30 hourly lowest-level winds, temperature and air density, with the per-hour threshold and transport rate of Pähtz & Durán (2023) J. Fluid Mech. 963, A20, doi:10.1017/jfm.2023.343, and the crest-mode methods outlined in Gunn, A. (2026) The distribution of Earth's wind-blown sand dunes. Nature Communications. doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75466-y
qsdiv_grid_text: on the EMARS 6° × 5.14° grid (periodic in longitude, one-sided at the ±84.86° rows)
rho_description: Mean over the hourly samples of Mars Year 30 of the lowest-layer air density rho_f = p/(R T) (p = mid pressure of the lowest EMARS layer, T = lowest-level temperature, R = 191.8 J kg-1 K-1).
fields_method: 23 sand-flux fields at 64 median grain diameters from the lowest-level winds, time-averaged over Mars Year 30 (one sample per Mars hour), per-sample threshold and flux (Pähtz & Durán 2023) with the crest-mode methods outlined in Gunn (2026) Nat Commun doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75466-y
